question: Why are equipotential surfaces always perpendicular to electric field lines? Justify your answer without using a diagram.

options.A: Along an equipotential surface, $\Delta V=0$ and work is zero; therefore electric field has no tangential component and must be normal to the surface
options.B: Equipotential surfaces are parallel to field lines so that work done is maximum
options.C: Equipotential surfaces are perpendicular because electric field is always zero near them
options.D: They are perpendicular only for a uniform electric field
